name: Eira Merlo
source:
Eira is a woman trying to thrive in a world of men. She can’t show any weakness, and she protects herself with a chilly exterior. She is already a very serious woman, but her line of work has pushed her into a stoic, silent presence.

As the MC gets to know Eira, she opens up to them. Her route begins with a tumultuous relationship between her and the MC, who feels that Eira doesn’t disclose enough information to them and that she makes decisions for others without considering their feelings or circumstances. As the route continues, MC begins to learn why Eira operates this way and (hopefully) understand that she means well.

[From strategy guide]
